cells.title: Adopt a finished herding job's worker in cells finish --from-job
cells.action: Apply D1 in the finish --from-job path of handlers_close.rs: when registered_worker_for_cell fails for trace.worker, and the job record names the cell and its result outcome is done, register a worker row (nickname = job id) for the cell, set trace.worker to it, append an audit row of kind worker-adopt, then cap as before. cells.title: Test that finish --from-job adopts a dead leader's job worker

cells.title: Name the cell's proof floor in the herding run settle line
cells.action: Apply D2 in herding/run.rs: where settle_command is called, load the cell, compute cell_proof_floor with the route class, and when the worker's proof result does not meet the floor (proof_meets_floor), print --proof-result <floor> and one more line that says to pass that floor only with its evidence (red-first evidence for green:red-first).

truths: the settle line for a test-role bugfix cell with a green:unit worker proof prints --proof-result green:red-first
the settle line is unchanged when the worker proof meets the floor

cells.title: Test the floor-aware settle line
cells.action: Add tests in the run.rs test module: a test-role cell under a bugfix route whose worker proof is green:unit gets a settle line naming green:red-first plus the evidence line; a code-role cell with green:unit gets the old line unchanged.

truths: a test drives the settle line with a below-floor proof and sees the floor
prohibitions: no change to production code unless a defect is found

cells.title: Let the Stop owner-ask check pass a step a guard refused as owner-only
cells.action: Apply D3: add the marker [owner-only: <target>] to the write-guard refusals for a governed config key, the team layer file (.bee/team.json and its global twin) and a write under the home dir outside the repo. In owner_ask_net.rs, collect the targets of [owner-only: <target>] markers from tool results in the transcript events, and return Pass when the matched reply names one of those targets. All other replies keep today's outcome.
cells.verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee -- owner_ask_net write_guard

truths: a reply asking the owner to run a write the guard refused as owner-only ends the turn with no refusal
a reply asking the owner to run a step with no owner-only refusal behind it is still refused
prohibitions: existing guard refusals keep their remedy text
must_haves.why: Spike F10: the Stop hook refused a turn end that asked the owner to run a write the guard refuses for the agent.
